But A said they wanted to leave, and you stood in the only doorway for five minutes, so they couldn't. That is a serious line to cross, whatever the intention. Blocking someone's exit takes away their choice, and it can feel frightening or controlling even when you only wanted resolution. A conversation someone is held in rarely resolves anything. Next time, let A go and say something like, \"I'm anxious. Can we pick this up in an hour?\" Then find a way to calm your panic on your own. A couples counselor could help you both handle conflict more safely."}
